build_conv_vae: build a convolutional VAE with an encoder and decoder for MNIST image reconstruction
create_conv_encoder: create a ConvEncoder Haiku module that outputs latent mean and standard deviation from input images
create_conv_decoder: create a ConvDecoder Haiku module that reconstructs image logits from latent vectors
compute_vae_loss: compute the VAE free energy loss combining binary cross-entropy and KL divergence terms
compute_kl_divergence: compute the batch KL divergence between a diagonal Gaussian and the standard normal distribution
